name: tech-lead
description: A tech-lead session that delivers a project as reviewed, green draft PRs through pr-worker agents. Hooks keep its directives across compactions, keep every red PR owned, gate pushes on local checks and PR text on a prose judge.

owner_name.title: Your name
owner_name.description: How agents refer to you, the person who reviews the PRs.

review_bot.title: Review bot login
review_bot.description: GitHub login (or login prefix) of the review bot whose review on the head commit gates readiness. Leave blank if you don't use one.

review_request.title: Review request comment
review_request.description: The PR comment that asks the review bot for a review, e.g. "@my-bot review". Leave blank if you don't use one.

tracker_publisher.title: Tracker publisher
tracker_publisher.description: Where the PR tracker page is published. "none" keeps it as a local HTML file in the lead directory. "superset" publishes it with the superset CLI.

push_gate.title: Push gate
push_gate.description: Where a git push needs check-head.sh to pass first: every session (all), only lead and worker sessions (lead), or nowhere (off). It covers repos that declare static checks.

prose_gate.title: PR prose gate
prose_gate.description: Where PR titles and bodies need the prose judge to pass first: every session (all), only lead and worker sessions (lead), or nowhere (off).

repos_dir.title: Repos directory
repos_dir.description: Directory holding your local checkouts, as <repos_dir>/<repo name>. The tracker rebases conflicting PRs there.

memory_dir.title: Memory directory
memory_dir.description: Directory where leads save lasting corrections as memory files, indexed in MEMORY.md. Leave blank to skip memory instructions.

lab_cli.title: Lab CLI
lab_cli.description: Command for remote lab machines (e.g. coder). Agents may use it for lab runs only, never for builds, tests or pushes. Leave blank if you have none.
